headline: Colorado Mesa end UCCS's unbeaten run
dek: UCCS had not lost before Wednesday's defeat at Colorado Mesa, on the night conference play opened. CSU Pueblo, who won at Westminster the same evening, are now the only side yet to drop a point, with seven wins from seven and three goals conceded in all of them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Regis, Colorado School of Mines and Adams State have together; the scoring is concentrated at the top of the chart and thins quickly below it.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo are the last unbeaten side in the conference after UCCS lost at Colorado Mesa.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.text: Fort Lewis's win at Colorado Christian on Thursday was their fourth of the season, beside two draws and two defeats.

findings.text: Adams State have scored two goals and conceded sixteen this season, across one win, one draw and five defeats, the fifth of them at MSU Denver on Thursday.

last_match.line: Fort Lewis's first win since beating Saint Edward's at home; Colorado Christian have yet to score in conference play.

next_match.line: CSU Pueblo have won every match they have played; Colorado Mesa have not lost since Midwestern State and ended UCCS's unbeaten run on Wednesday.
